status: Local candidate verified; queued repair no longer downloads receipt bodies. Production remains the deployed inline-deadline runtime.
change: Queued process repair sends the native R2 listing key/ETag directly. The existing Queue consumer validates the current receipt, authority, lifetime and claim ETag. Running/cancelling bodies still provide deadlines; terminal receipts are skipped.

measurement.runtime: Native Alchemy workerd, R2 and Queue; local Bun 1.4.3 shared Linux host.
measurement.observer: The test Control entrypoint counts get calls and delegates every operation to the real R2 binding. No canned storage responses or execution replacements.
measurement.regression: The same counter assertion failed against the previous repair owner (103 actual vs 1 expected), then passed after the change. Replacement Worker, more than one native Queue batch, terminal skipping, retained active work and repeated delivery with exactly one confirmed append are covered.
measurement.limits: Counts are receipt GET invocations inside repair, not a measurement of total R2 billing, Queue charges, transferred bytes, production latency or throughput.
